description: Source code for a React-based GuideRenderer class that processes JSONContent to generate JSX elements, including table of contents, questions, and various content nodes.

classes.name: GuideRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders JSONContent into JSX elements, supporting headings, text, marks, tables, questions, and more.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts JSONContent into an array of JSX elements.

methods.name: tableOfContents
methods.description: Generates a table of contents based on headings and QA sections within the JSONContent.

methods.name: headlines
methods.description: Extracts heading information from JSONContent for TOC generation.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Recursively retrieves text content from a JSONContent node.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Renders child nodes of a JSONContent node into JSX elements.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Dispatches rendering based on node type.

methods.name: renderMark
methods.description: Wraps text with appropriate mark styles like bold, italic, underline, link.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Renders text nodes, applying marks if present.

methods.name: strike
methods.description: Wraps content in <s> with line-through style.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates an anchor tag, opening external links in new tab.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Renders heading tags (h1-h6) with slug IDs.

methods.name: codeBlock
methods.description: Renders code block with header and content.

methods.name: questions
methods.description: Extracts questions and answers from a qaSection node.

methods.name: qaSection
methods.description: Renders a QA section with questions, flashcards, and question list.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Renders a table with optional header.
